primary_analysis: Run paired_binary_analysis_v1 on execution/raw_results.jsonl (schema paired_binary_episode_v1 v1.0) to compute the preregistered estimand paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline on the completed paired dataset (N=300 completed pairs; completed_episode_count=600). Use the preregistered primary failed_call_treatment 'complete_pair_primary'. Two‑sided test at α=0.05. Report observed paired difference, 95% confidence interval, two‑sided p‑value, and the preregistered effect‑size measure. All inputs (seeds, task_manifest, model_configuration, execution_log) from execution/*.jsonl are used verbatim.
secondary_analyses: per_task_failure_rate_guarded — compute guarded condition validator failure proportion (overall and stratified by intent cluster: reachability,isolation,ACLs,route policies) from execution/raw_results.jsonl (exploratory).
per_task_failure_rate_baseline — compute baseline condition validator failure proportion (overall and stratified by intent cluster) from execution/raw_results.jsonl (exploratory).
effect_size_Cohen_h_equivalent_for_paired_proportions — compute the preregistered effect‑size equivalent for paired proportions (exploratory).
per‑cluster paired differences (exploratory) — compute paired estimand within each intent cluster (75 tasks per cluster); label exploratory.
failure‑pattern clustering (exploratory) — cluster validator/canonicalizer diagnostics and repair invocation patterns from execution/raw_results.jsonl for qualitative failure‑mode analysis.
sensitivity_analyses: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity — recompute primary estimand treating any missing/failed model call as validator failure (0) as preregistered sensitivity.

(Exploratory) report effect on primary estimand when excluding tasks flagged as 'ambiguous_specification' or excluded per contamination rules (items and reasons taken from execution/execution_log.jsonl).
uncertainty_quantification: Report 95% confidence interval for the paired difference, two‑sided p‑value (α=0.05), and the preregistered effect‑size measure. Uncertainty summaries are produced by the registered analysis executor using the sealed analysis code and recorded seeds/manifests.
multiplicity_implementation: Single pre‑specified primary confirmatory hypothesis (H1) — no multiplicity correction for the primary test per preregistration. All other comparisons are explicitly exploratory; when multi‑comparison adjustment is reported for exploratory contrasts, use Holm–Bonferroni and label results as exploratory.
contamination_analysis: Deterministic redaction pipeline and static private‑data regex checks were applied as preregistered; exclusions and re‑generation events are recorded in execution/execution_log.jsonl and task_manifest. SHA‑256 artifact hashing is recorded (preregistration_sha256 present; artifact_hashes_total_count=2108). Items matching blacklisted patterns or returning 'ambiguous_specification' are excluded from the confirmatory set and recorded with hashes and reasons in the execution manifest (no manual adjudication).
